inherited_records.quote: L_a is Burnol's extended Sonine space: functions constant on (0,a) whose cosine transform is again constant on (0,a).
kappa_{a,w}=T_a^*K_a^Gamma(.,w) requires Burnol explicit Bessel/Hankel resolvent formula for P_{L_a^Gamma}.
P_eta and all actual H_eta tests require kappa_{a,rho,k}=T_a^* partial K_a^Gamma(.,rho).

surveyed_burnol_papers.citation: Burnol, Sur certains espaces de Hilbert de fonctions entieres, lies a la transformation de Fourier et aux fonctions L de Dirichlet et de Riemann, 2001
surveyed_burnol_papers.finding: constructs a Sonine subspace related to zeta and vectors attached to nontrivial zeros; no exact P_{L_a^Gamma} formula identified

surveyed_burnol_papers.citation: Burnol, Sur les espaces de Sonine associes par de Branges a la transformation de Fourier, 2002
surveyed_burnol_papers.finding: explicit formulas for de Branges E(z) functions of Sonine spaces; adjacent but not the requested ambient-to-legal projection resolvent
co-Poisson and Fourier-zeta framework source; related carrier theory but no located projected kernel formula

surveyed_burnol_papers.citation: Burnol, Two complete and minimal systems associated with the zeros of the Riemann zeta function, 2004
surveyed_burnol_papers.finding: complete/minimal systems in extended Sonine spaces; relevant zero-evaluator context, not the projection resolvent

surveyed_burnol_papers.citation: Burnol, Spacetime causality in the study of the Hankel transform, 2006
surveyed_burnol_papers.finding: Hankel transform support-property theorem via causality; adjacent support theory but not the completed zeta/Sonine projection

surveyed_burnol_papers.citation: Burnol, Scattering, determinants, hyperfunctions in relation to Gamma(1-s)/Gamma(s), 2006/2008
surveyed_burnol_papers.finding: closest candidate: finite-interval J0 Hankel Fredholm determinants and resolvent-as-reproducing-kernel appendix; still not identified as P_{L_a^Gamma}K_a^{Gamma,amb}
co-Poisson full paper with references to the Sonine program; no exact projected-kernel formula located in accessible metadata

surveyed_adjacent_classical.citation: de Branges, Hilbert Spaces of Entire Functions, 1968

specific_findings.detail: Step 153 already supplies K_a^{Gamma,amb}; this is not enough because public-shadow promotion is forbidden.

specific_findings.item: de Branges E-functions for Fourier Sonine spaces
specific_findings.detail: Burnol 2002 supplies explicit E(z) functions; a future derivation may turn this into a kernel, but the audit did not identify the exact P_{L_a^Gamma} projection formula.
Burnol 2006/2008 gives finite-interval J0 Fredholm determinants and resolvent-as-RKHS content; exact match to the completed zeta/Sonine projection remains unverified.
No surveyed citation exposes K_a^Gamma=P_{L_a^Gamma}K_a^{Gamma,amb} or kappa_{a,w}=T_a^*K_a^Gamma(.,w).
